findings.detail: The approximately £45,000 cited as proceeds appears to use the GIA's current account value as though it were the value of the proceeds from disinvestment; the source describes the amount as the live account value, not confirmed net proceeds.
The report allocates the estimated proceeds to ISA top-ups before those proceeds have been received from the GIA disinvestment.
